description: Declared deploy bundle for the hermes-self-report cron. This file IS the bundle the installer copies; nothing outside its 'files' list is written. Brain authors the canonical report builder; this repository carries its exact-byte runtime mirror plus Mini-only lifecycle continuity adapter. SKILL.md is installed only with --include-skill --brain-path.

coexist_required.reason: Read by the claim/snapshot-freshness logic. Runtime state, outside the bundle. Installer warns, never installs or removes it.

hermes_report_build._row_cost() imports spend_opencode.served_row_cost to strip subscription-covered (Codex OAuth) phantom spend from LEGACY writer-served rows (86e2hap1g). Owned by the spend bundle, not this one; a missing copy fails open to the raw recorded cost, so the digest over-reports rather than breaks. Installer warns, never installs or removes it.

files.role: exact-byte runtime mirror of Brain canonical report builder; owns HTML+text+subject+JSON, team-wide review queue, separated spend labels, and nominal-slot-bound System-signal-only Activity continuity consumption
load-bearing data-collection library imported by the builder as hermes_report_build_v1lib; its own table renderer is deprecated but the module is not retirable
compat-only orphan; no live importer (survey confirmed). Ships until a follow-up PR retires it after a final cross-surface caller check
standalone per-list ClickUp metrics CLI; no automated caller; live copy uses runtime-current venv path + lazy_secret_resolver token

RC4 delivery contract plus 86e2gczqw alert subject flagging: venv re-exec, lazy token resolve, Postmark POST with in-code hermes-send fallback, receipt, nonzero-exit-on-total-failure. Canon = deploy mirror bytes (live behavior + encoding=utf-8)

receipt-reader probe for its own no_agent cron (offset from 0 */6 * * *): 0 fresh+sent, 1 both channels failed, 2 missing/stale/unreadable. Canon = deploy mirror bytes (live behavior + encoding=utf-8)

stdlib-only Mini lifecycle outbox; durable UTC-day JSONL emission, immutable required-producer coverage, event-specific ClickUp transition identity, read-only range API, retention, deduplication, and explicit UNKNOWN health
read-only Hermes Mac mini continuity adapter; explicit nominal UTC slots, two-window coverage, exact event-kind ClickUp parity, fail-closed health/provenance, and strict-completion independence
queue-poller durable claim store and claim-event shadow-outbox producer; emits only after the claim file and directory are fsynced and degrades visibly on fail-open paths
no-agent merged and DB-publish closeout writer; emits review handoff facts only after guarded ClickUp success and read-after-write verification
authored cron contract (Brain source of truth), including explicit nominal scheduled-slot propagation; installed only with --include-skill --brain-path <brain checkout>
